question: Was DNS the cause of the webhook backlog?

claims.text:
SYNTHETIC BUSINESS VALIDATION
The webhook backlog came from an exhausted worker pool, not DNS resolution.

SYNTHETIC BUSINESS VALIDATION
A webhook DNS explanation was withdrawn at 08:40; the worker pool was confirmed at 09:10.

SYNTHETIC BUSINESS VALIDATION
For webhook backlog, pause noncritical jobs before adding workers; do not retry every webhook.
Final root cause: retry configuration mismatched the timeout budget, causing a backlog of duplicate requests. Confirmed at 10:00 +08:00. Follow-ups: PAY-102 and PAY-103.

SYNTHETIC BUSINESS VALIDATION
Webhook latency targets apply to the pilot only; no general customer latency guarantee is approved.

SYNTHETIC BUSINESS VALIDATION
HOOK-410 worker expansion is Done. HOOK-411 load shedding is In Progress. Owner: Ravi.
PAY-102 code fix: Done. Code completion does not approve general customer release.
PAY-103 protective measures: In Progress. Owner: Maya.
